      "keystrokes": "python3 - <<'PY'
import fasttext
import os
import time

configs = [
    (10, 0.1),
    (10, 0.2),
    (10, 0.3),
    (15, 0.1),
    (15, 0.2),
]

best_acc = 0
best_config = None
best_model_path = '/app/work/model_best_nolower.bin'

for epoch, lr in configs:
    print(f'\n=== Training epoch={epoch}, lr={lr} ===')
    start = time.time()
    model = fasttext.train_supervised(
        input='/app/work/train.txt',
        dim=10,
        bucket=200000,
        wordNgrams=2,
        epoch=epoch,
        lr=lr,
        minCount=2,
        thread=4,
        verbose=0
    )
    t = time.time() - start
    result = model.test('/app/work/test.txt')
    size = os.path.getsize('/app/work/train.txt')  # dummy, model not saved yet
    print(f'  time={t:.1f}s, accuracy={result[1]:.4f}')
    if result[1] > best_acc:
        best_acc = result[1]
        best_config = (epoch, lr)
        model.save_model(best_model_path)
        print(f'  *** New best! Saved to {best_model_path}')

print(f'\nBest config: epoch={best_config[0]}, lr={best_config[1]}, accuracy={best_acc:.4f}')
